title: 11. Relationship Between Governor and Council of Ministers

blocks.content:
• Governor normally acts on advice of Council of Ministers
• Advice is binding except in discretionary matters
• Council of Ministers communicates decisions to Governor
Advice is binding except in discretionary matters

items: Exams frequently test if the Council of Ministers' advice is binding (it is binding except in discretionary matters).
Remember that decision communication flows from the Council of Ministers to the Governor.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Governor normally acts on the advice tendered by the Council of Ministers.
The advice provided by the Council of Ministers is binding on the Governor, except in discretionary matters.
The Council of Ministers is responsible for communicating its administrative decisions to the Governor.
